desc: **Task 0 (ideation):** Derive the O(N log N + M) approach and the incremental delta formula `2·sumPos[v] − cnt[v] − cnt[v]·N`.
**Task 1 (implementation):** Single-file solution combining fast I/O, `cnt`/`sumPos` precomputation, Fenwick-based base inversion count, the incremental recurrence, and batched output.
**Task 2 (derivation verification):** Per-element delta re-derived (2p_r − 2r + c − N) and summed to the closed form; consistent.
**Task 3 (validation):** Hand-verified all three samples (7,3,3,1,1,5 for sample 2; 3,1,1; 0,6,10,12,12,10,6), plus edge cases N=1 and M=1; Fenwick loop cost ≈7M ops at N=M=2×10⁵, acceptable.
